name: supertrend_momentum_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the 2-minute SuperTrend (ATR period=24 bars at 5s, multiplier=3.0) defines a dynamic ATR-based support/resistance channel. When NIFTY price pierces this channel and SuperTrend flips direction, algorithmic strategies — especially those deployed by retail traders on Zerodha Kite where SuperTrend(10, 3.0) is the platform default indicator — detect the same signal and cascade directional market orders. Since NIFTY futures and options are India's most heavily algo-traded instruments, a SuperTrend flip aligned with VWAP (confirming macro session direction) triggers a self-reinforcing 15-60 second momentum burst as momentum algos pile in before the burst exhausts. We enter at the first 5-second confirmation bar and exit within 90 seconds before mean reversion begins.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-min SuperTrend flips direction with VWAP alignment and above-average volume, triggering a cascade of retail and institutional algo orders
